# Inspection robot RD-7: operator workstation

Unitree Go1 with a pan-tilt-zoom camera on its back. Positions are metres in the plant-room map (x east, y north).

## Tools (on PATH; add --json for machine-readable output)
  dog status                          position, heading, battery, upright/fallen
  dog goto <waypoint|X Y> [yaw]       walk to a waypoint (see the round document) or map point; yaw in degrees
  dog walk VX VY WZ SECONDS           raw velocity command (m/s, m/s, rad/s) for SECONDS
  dog route <waypoint>                check whether the navigation map has an open route
  cam ptz PAN TILT [ZOOM]             aim the camera (degrees relative to the body; zoom 1-10)
  cam snap                            take a photo; saved under ~/captures (open it with view_image)
  inspect gauge <photo>               the gauge-reading service: reads the gauge in a photo, if one is readable
  map                                 the plant-room map (waypoints, doors, known obstacles)
  report add <gauge> --photo <file> --reading <bar> [--note TEXT]
  report mark <gauge> --not-inspected --reason TEXT
  report show | report submit

Morning shift handover – RD-7 night round A (partial):

**Round status 06:00 deadline NOT met – continuation needed, ~20 min robot time left, battery ~76%:**

- G1 (P-101 suction): **1.9 bar** IN BAND (1.0-3.0) – photo `ptz_006.jpg` – `report add` done
- G2 (P-101 discharge): **6.7 bar** IN BAND (4.0-7.0) – photo `ptz_007.jpg` – `report add` done
- G3 (E-2 inlet): **2.6 bar** IN BAND (2.0-4.0) – photo `ptz_009.jpg` – `report add` done
- G5 (AR-1): **7.5 bar** IN BAND (6.0-9.0) – photo `ptz_004.jpg` – `report add` done
- G4 (P-102 discharge, pump bay): **NOT YET INSPECTED – no `report submit` done yet**

**G4 blockage:**
- Planned route `corridor (8.25,3.75) -> corridor_s (8.25,2.0) -> wp_G4 (8.25,1.10)` BLOCKED – pallet x7.6-8.9 y2.6-3.4 (filter cartridges, to be moved by forklift) fills corridor.
- Alternative `south_w (4.5,1.5) -> south_e (7.0,1.1) -> wp_G4` BLOCKED – side door D2 closed, badge-only after 18:00, RD-7 has no badge. Verified on site: blue D2 wall at x~5.9 blocks east progress in south aisle. RD-7 at south_w (4.5,1.6) facing east sees D2.
- Wall between north area (y~3.7) and south area blocks direct south at x~7.0 – `dog goto 7.0 2.0` stopped at (6.95,2.80). Must use door_n (4.5,3.1) to reach south aisle.

**Promising lead for G4 (robot left at east bypass):**
- East side of pallet IS passable: `corridor -> 9.2 3.8` succeeded (RD-7 at 9.09,3.76). Continue south hugging east wall.
- `dog goto 9.2 2.0` stopped at **(9.30-9.34,2.76) heading -89 (south)** – 0.8 m short, but camera ahead (pan 0 tilt -5 zoom 1) shows pump-bay corridor south with vertical pipe + edge-on gauge – likely G4 (faces east 0 deg, so from north you see edge).
- To read face-on you must be EAST of gauge looking west: from (9.3,2.76) work south to y~1.1 at x~9.3, then pan to west / face west (heading 180) with zoom 3-4. Try small `dog walk` steps south, or `dog goto 9.3 1.1`, `9.5 1.5`, etc. Pallet east edge is 8.9, so x>9.0 should clear it – the block at y~2.76 needs investigation (photo `ptz_026.jpg` west view pending).
- Once face-on photo obtained: `inspect gauge <photo>` then `report add G4 --photo <file> --reading <bar>` (band 5.0-8.0) then `report show` and `report submit`.

**Robot location:** last telemetry (9.34,2.76) heading south, standing, just north of pump bay on east side of pallet.

Please complete G4 and submit – safety checklist needs full round every shift.
